intro.h2: One craftsman, from cabinets to the tricky jobs
paragraphs: Ogden Woodworking builds custom cabinets in Goleta from its shop at 375 Pine Ave, and owner Craig Ogden does the work himself. The sign over the door lists cabinets, furniture, CNC milling and wood signs, and reviewers add countertops, custom doors and cabinet repairs to that list.

Customers hire Craig for honest fixes and hard problems. He has reworked cabinets that others said to replace, hung custom doors in the twisted frames of an old multistory building, and fitted chemical resistant countertops for a laboratory that has since hired him again for a second location. Reviewers call him professional, courteous and local.

items.name: Custom cabinets
items.blurb: Cabinets built and installed for kitchens, offices and work spaces, from white shaker kitchens with crown molding to charcoal slab-door cabinets with frosted glass uppers. One reviewer says Craig installed custom cabinets within the time frame allowed and calls his quality control and craftsmanship outstanding.

items.name: Countertops, including lab tops
items.blurb: Countertop cutting and installation is a recurring topic in reviews. Craig has installed chemical resistant countertops with integrated sinks for a laboratory, and the client liked the work enough to bring him back for a second location.

items.name: Cabinet repair and refacing
items.blurb: Before you replace everything, ask Craig. One family had been told by others they needed all new cabinets. He reworked theirs instead, replacing doors and hinges, leveling the boxes and fitting sturdy soft-close hinges, so every door now opens and closes with ease.

about.text: Ogden Woodworking is Craig Ogden's woodworking shop at 375 Pine Ave in Goleta, California. The teal sign over the door spells out what he does: cabinets, furniture, CNC milling and wood signs. Craig builds in a full woodshop and installs on site. Of one build he posted that it was an interesting project, that he was pretty happy with the result and learned a few things, and that what mattered more was happy customers. Reviewers describe him as detailed, professional and local, and several came to him by recommendation, one through a cabinet contractor.

image.alt: Inside the Ogden Woodworking shop in Goleta with workbenches, saws and lumber

process.h2: How a project with Craig works

steps.title: Call or stop by
steps.text: Call (805) 680-5867 Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, and describe your cabinets, countertops or carpentry job.

steps.title: Look at what you have
steps.text: Craig looks at your space and existing cabinets, and can tell you when a repair or new doors make more sense than replacing everything.

steps.title: Build in the shop
steps.text: Cabinets, doors, countertops and custom pieces are built and cut in the Pine Ave woodshop.

steps.title: Install on time
steps.text: Craig installs within the agreed time frame, adjusting for twisted door frames, out-of-level cabinets and older buildings as he goes.

items.name: Chad H.
items.text: I was lucky enough to find Craig through a cabinet contractor.  We needed chemical resistant countertops for a laboratory.  I have been getting compliments since day one.  I now have him putting in countertops at a second location.  Highly recommend Ogden Woodworking!

items.name: Memory T.
items.text:
Craig Ogden Detailed Custom Carpentry. He installed custom cabinets and doors within the time frame allowed. His quality control and craftsmanship is outstanding.
The installation of the doors were particularly challenging because the door frames are in an old multistory building, and many of the doorframes were twisted. Greg compensated for the twisted frames by adjusting the contact points. Now the doors stay open and do not move once they are opened. I highly recommend him.

items.name: Calista M.
items.text: We had such a wonderful experience with Ogden Woodworking.  We had been given the run around by others, told we needed all new cabinets, upsold etc.  Craig reworked our cabinets replacing doors, hinges, leveling and really working magic.  We can now open and close all our cabinets with ease and he installed soft close sturdy hinges.  He was an all around nice guy, professional, courteous and local.  Would recommend 10/10

service_area.h2: Custom cabinets in Goleta and nearby
service_area.text: Ogden Woodworking works from its shop at 375 Pine Ave #13 in Goleta, California, building in the shop and installing in homes, offices and labs. Customers describe Craig as local, and several found him through recommendations, including from a cabinet contractor. If you are in or around Goleta and want to know whether your project fits his schedule, call (805) 680-5867 on a weekday.

items.q: Do I need all new cabinets?
items.a: Not always. Craig has reworked existing cabinets for customers who were told by others to replace everything: new doors, new soft-close hinges and leveling, so every door opens and closes with ease. He can look at yours and tell you whether repair or replacement makes sense.

Yes. Ogden Woodworking is a cabinet maker, and the shop sign lists cabinets first. Craig builds and installs custom cabinets for kitchens, offices and work spaces, and customers say he installed their cabinets and doors within the time frame allowed.

Yes. Countertop cutting is one of the topics reviewers mention. Craig installed chemical resistant countertops with integrated sinks for a laboratory, and that client has since had him put in countertops at a second location. Call to talk through the material your project needs.

items.q: What else does the shop make?
items.a: Besides cabinets, the sign over the shop lists furniture, CNC milling and wood signs. Craig has also built and hung custom interior doors, including in an old multistory building with twisted frames, so the doors now stay open and do not move.

items.q: What are your hours and how do I reach you?
items.a: The shop is open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM and closed on weekends. Call (805) 680-5867 or email sbpoolleague@cox.net with photos and a short description of your project, and include your address in Goleta or nearby.

final_cta.h2: Have a cabinet or woodworking job in mind?
final_cta.text: Call Craig at the Pine Ave shop, weekdays 8 to 5.
